description: This file contains a class definition for a Zend OAuth Provider, implementing OAuth protocol functionality such as validation, token handling, and request processing within the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: Zend_Oauth_Provider
classes.description: A class implementing an OAuth provider mechanism, handling request validation, token management, and OAuth protocol steps.

methods.name: setConsumerHandler
methods.description: Sets the callback handler for consumer key validation.

methods.name: setTimestampNonceHandler
methods.description: Sets the handler for nonce and timestamp validation.

methods.name: setTokenHandler
methods.description: Sets the handler for token validation.

methods.name: setRequestTokenPath
methods.description: Sets the URL path for requesting tokens.

methods.name: isRequestTokenEndpoint
methods.description: Designates this request as a token endpoint.

methods.name: reportProblem
methods.description: Generates an error report string based on OAuth exceptions.

methods.name: checkOAuthRequest
methods.description: Validates an incoming OAuth request, checking parameters, signatures, and tokens.

methods.name: generateToken
methods.description: Generates a random token of specified size.
